=*Shared-use approval — {{ $json.room }}*
{{ $json.requesterName }} wants *{{ $json.room }}* (your standing hold) for:
*Date:* {{ $json.bookingDateHuman }}
*Time:* {{ $json.timeHuman }}

This overlaps the {{ $json.holdOwner }} hold, so it needs your OK.
Respond by *{{ $json.deadlineHuman }}* — if I don't hear back by then the room is treated as free and I'll book it.

✅ Approve →  {{ $execution.resumeUrl }}?decision=approve
❌ Decline →  {{ $execution.resumeUrl }}?decision=decline

={{ $('Resolve Outcome').item.json.reason === 'approved' ? ($('Resolve Outcome').item.json.approverName + ' approved it — you\'re booked.') : ('No word back from ' + $('Resolve Outcome').item.json.approverName + ' by the window, so ' + $('Resolve Outcome').item.json.room + ' is yours — booked.') }}
*{{ $('Resolve Outcome').item.json.room }}* · {{ $('Resolve Outcome').item.json.bookingDateHuman }} · {{ $('Resolve Outcome').item.json.timeHuman }}

={{ $json.slot === 'past' ? ('That ' + $json.room + ' slot is now in the past, so I didn\'t book it — send me a new date and time.') : ('Couldn\'t book ' + $json.room + ' — it got taken in the meantime (' + $json.conflictTitle + '). Want a different booth or time?') }}

={{ $('Resolve Outcome').item.json.approverName }} wasn't able to release *{{ $('Resolve Outcome').item.json.room }}* for {{ $('Resolve Outcome').item.json.bookingDateHuman }} ({{ $('Resolve Outcome').item.json.timeHuman }}), so I didn't book it.
Want me to check another M booth for that window, or a different time?
